cues: The binomial theorem gives n plus one terms with coefficients n C r.
The general term is T r plus one.
The coefficients sum to two to the n.
For any index the series is infinite and needs x less than one in size.
Approximate roots by splitting off the nearest perfect power.
And e is the sum of one over r factorial.
text: Quick recap. The binomial theorem gives n plus one terms with coefficients n C r. The general term is T r plus one. The coefficients sum to two to the n. For any index the series is infinite and needs x less than one in size. Approximate roots by splitting off the nearest perfect power. And e is the sum of one over r factorial.
